case.message: What does it cost me to use QuotesDone?
case.facts: AUDIENCE: this number belongs to a REGISTERED CUSTOMER. Treat them as a customer.
case.expect: posting and comparing are free; 3% reveal fee of the chosen quote, no card fee, no VAT on it

replies.text: Posting a request and receiving and comparing quotes are free. If you choose a quote and reveal that supplier’s details, the fee is 3% of the final quoted price after any discount, excluding VAT. No card fee is added, and no VAT is charged on the reveal fee.

Posting your request, receiving quotes and comparing them is free. You only pay when you choose a supplier and want to unlock their identity and contact details: a 3% reveal fee on the selected quote's final price (after any discount, excluding VAT). For example, a quote of AED 10,000 ex-VAT means a fee of AED 300. There is no cap. No card fee is added and no VAT is charged on this fee. You can cancel before reveal or decline every quote at no cost. Are you planning a job now?

candidate.why: Gives the fee facts exactly as the brief states them, with the base after discount and ex-VAT.

control.why: Facts and the AED 300 example are correct, but it is long and ends with a needless intake question.

case.message: If I pay the reveal fee and the supplier does not answer, do I get a refund?
case.facts: AUDIENCE: this number belongs to a REGISTERED CUSTOMER. Treat them as a customer.
case.expect: states the refund position from the brief without promising a refund

replies.text: If the supplier does not respond, QuotesDone chases them on working day 3 and sends the case to the CEO for a final decision on working day 5. If the supplier is still silent, the full amount you paid is refunded; nothing is deducted. Refunds are not automatic, and your bank may take 7–14 working days to show the refund. Working days are Monday to Friday, excluding UAE public holidays.

candidate.why: The ladder is correct and no refund is promised, but it never says the refund is the full amount via the CEO's decision, and the statement that refunds are not automatic is slightly muddled alongside "is refunded".

Send the revised quotation from the job; it replaces the earlier submission for that option and is checked again. If the customer has already revealed you, the revealed quotation remains binding during its validity, and any change must be agreed directly with the customer.

Revising works differently depending on whether the customer has revealed you yet. Job 7731 is still open, so no reveal has happened. In that case, open Job 7731 under Inquiries received, send a revised quotation, and attach or type it as you did before. The new submission replaces your earlier one for that option and is checked again. Please state exact specs, lead time, validity and VAT basis, and keep phone numbers, emails and your company name out of it. You can also withdraw the earlier quote if you prefer. Once a customer reveals you, the quote binds within its validity and any change is agreed directly with them.

control.why: Names a portal section, "Inquiries received", that the brief does not state, and the reply is wordy and starts with an awkward framing.

candidate.why: Concise and accurate on the refresh before reveal and the binding after reveal.

case.message: How does QuotesDone work?
case.expect: post a request free, verified suppliers quote anonymously, compare, reveal fee 3%

replies.text: Describe your job on QuotesDone and the Smart Engine helps make the brief ready for pricing. We match it with suitable verified UAE suppliers, who send anonymous quotes. You compare them for free, then pay a 3% reveal fee on the selected quote to unlock that supplier’s details. No card fee is added, and no VAT is charged on the reveal fee. You then agree the scope, price and timing directly with the supplier; QuotesDone does not hold payment for the work.

candidate.why: Gives an accurate, concise overview of the flow and the fee, and says there is no escrow.

replies.text: تبدأ بإنشاء حساب وتأكيد رقم هاتفك وبريدك الإلكتروني، ثم تصف شغلك كتابةً أو ترسل صورة أو مخطط. بعد اكتمال التفاصيل، نطابق الطلب مع موردين مناسبين ويرسلون عروضًا مجهولة الهوية؛ غالبًا تصل خلال 3–5 أيام عمل. تقارن العروض مجانًا، وإذا اخترت عرضًا تدفع 3% من قيمته النهائية بعد الخصم، دون احتساب ضريبة المورد. لا تُضاف رسوم بطاقة ولا تُفرض ضريبة على رسوم الكشف.

candidate.why: Accurate walkthrough with 3–5 days, free comparison and 3% fee; fits the brief.
